description: Mexico's largest digital bank — the foundational banking infrastructure that formalized consumer finance for a country where 63% of adults were unbanked at the time of investment. Albo replaced legacy branch-dependent banking with a mobile-first platform, proving that emerging market consumers will adopt institutional-grade financial products when the friction is removed.

SaaS-based technology stack for residential property developers — a Shopify-like platform providing digital go-to-market infrastructure for direct-to-consumer home sales channels. Alo Home replaces the traditional broker dependency with tools for virtual tours, digital closings, and CRM, giving developers institutional sales capabilities at startup cost.
Social commerce marketplace enabling anyone to become an online store owner through access to discounted inventory, logistics, and technology.
Digital operating system for beauty salons — back-office management, scheduling, and operations infrastructure for small service businesses.

Personal finance consolidation platform aggregating cards, accounts, and financial services into a single interface. Conomy gives consumers visibility across their fragmented financial relationships and incentivizes healthy financial behavior through rewards — building the consumer data layer that traditional banks refuse to share.

B2B IoT analytics platform providing merchants and F&B retailers with real-time inventory optimization and consumer demand intelligence. Enjoy turned point-of-sale hardware into a data layer — giving small operators the same demand forecasting capabilities that large retail chains build in-house.

Vietnam's leading digital investment platform and fully licensed brokerage — formalizing a cash-dominated economy into structured capital markets participation. Finhay provides savings, investment products, and digital financial services to an underserved population of 100 million, building the foundational wealth infrastructure for Southeast Asia's fastest-growing economy.

Latin America's largest freight-matching ecosystem — connecting over 1 million heavy-duty trucks to cargo in real time. Frete goes beyond matching: it layers embedded financial services, risk management, truck monitoring, and route optimization on top of the logistics network. The platform is restructuring Brazil's $100B+ freight industry from a fragmented, broker-dependent market into a data-driven infrastructure.

Global sports media technology company operating across three verticals: Fanatiz, a direct-to-consumer streaming platform serving live and on-demand sports content across 100+ markets; 1190 Sports, a rights management and commercialization business representing leagues and federations including Argentina's Professional Football League, Brazil's Campeonato Paulistão, and Peru's Liga 1; and Nunchee, the proprietary streaming technology platform powering third-party sports OTT services. Fz Sports controls the full value chain — from rights acquisition to distribution infrastructure to consumer delivery — across the world's most passionate sports markets.
AI-driven precision medicine platform for diabetes management, integrating with medical devices to deliver personalized treatment recommendations.

Cross-border brokerage unlocking US capital markets for Latin American retail investors — starting at $5 minimums with US custody and SIPC insurance. Hapi removes the geographic and regulatory barriers that have historically excluded Latin American savers from the world's deepest capital markets, providing the same access that US residents take for granted.
Creator monetization infrastructure enabling Latin American creators to earn from micro-content, courses, and subscriptions across social media platforms.

PropTech marketplace enabling fractional co-ownership of cross-border luxury vacation homes. Kocomo provides the legal, operational, and technology infrastructure that makes shared ownership of international real estate accessible — handling property management, scheduling, and compliance across jurisdictions.

B2B embedded credit platform giving distributors and SMEs access to net-30/60 payment terms at the point of transaction. Kontempo solves the working capital gap that forces small businesses to choose between growth and liquidity — embedding financing directly into the supply chain rather than requiring a separate lending relationship.

Payment infrastructure bridging fiat currencies and digital assets across Latin America. Koywe provides the API layer that allows fintechs, exchanges, and platforms to offer on/off ramps between traditional banking and blockchain ecosystems — solving the cross-border payment friction that legacy banking infrastructure creates.

B2B fintech digitizing the mortgage and lending process end-to-end, from application to closing. Lenk replaces the paper-heavy, weeks-long origination workflow with digital infrastructure — reducing processing time, improving underwriting accuracy, and giving lenders institutional-grade operations without institutional-grade IT budgets.

Tech-driven last-mile logistics operator and market leader in Colombia. Combines express delivery, same/next-day fulfillment, and urban micro-warehousing with an embedded fintech arm — providing the full delivery infrastructure stack that allows Colombian businesses to compete with enterprise-grade logistics without building it themselves.

Back-office infrastructure and supply chain consolidation powering Latin America's top e-commerce brands. Merama acquires and operates category-leading online merchants — providing the capital, operations, and logistics infrastructure that individual sellers cannot build alone. The platform transforms fragmented e-commerce entrepreneurs into institutional-scale consumer brands.

Corporate digital therapeutics platform combining behavioral science, clinical data, and AI to reduce chronic disease costs across Southeast Asia. Naluri embedded itself into corporate insurance infrastructure — replacing episodic medical interventions with continuous, data-driven health management at scale.

Digital freight forwarder simplifying international trade for mid-market companies across Southeast Asia. Neuports replaces the fragmented, paper-heavy customs and shipping process with AI-driven supply chain tools — giving SME exporters and importers the same cross-border logistics capabilities that only large trading houses previously accessed.
Surplus food supply chain — grocery subscription delivering discounted misfits and surplus produce with home delivery.

Automated treasury management platform replacing manual cash cycle operations with infrastructure that runs itself. Radar automates the movement, reconciliation, and reporting of corporate cash flows — deleting the operational overhead that forces mid-market companies to hire dedicated treasury teams.

Modular banking-as-a-service platform enabling companies to build and launch financial products through blockchain-native infrastructure. Licensed and regulated across European markets, Striga provided the compliance and payment rails that allowed fintechs to go live in weeks rather than years.

Embedded finance infrastructure enabling any company to issue cards, manage accounts, and process payments without becoming a regulated financial institution. Swap abstracted the complexity of Brazilian banking regulation into API calls — turning its clients into fintechs without the compliance overhead. A foundational rails play.

description: Skill-based esports infrastructure enabling competitive gamers to monetize their matches through structured wagering. Tipspace creates the competitive gaming ecosystem — matchmaking, tournament infrastructure, and payment rails — that transforms casual gaming into a structured, revenue-generating activity for players.

Treinta replaced paper ledgers with a mobile-first platform for accounting, inventory, payments, and online sales — growing to 7 million businesses across 18 countries. Raised $60M in one of Colombia's largest Series A rounds. In 2025, launched an AI builder enabling entrepreneurs to create websites and automations through natural language.

description: Agri-fintech delivering faster, cheaper, and more transparent credit to small and medium farmers through an agent-operated digital platform. Verde solves the structural problem that keeps rural producers locked into predatory lending: the absence of digital infrastructure connecting agricultural output data to credit decisions.

Canada's leading wealth management platform — automated investing, commission-free stock and crypto trading, peer-to-peer payments, and tax optimization. WealthSimple has redefined how an entire country's population accesses capital markets, growing to over $50B in assets under management. The definitive proof that institutional-grade financial infrastructure can be built for the individual investor.

description: Wealth management platform for Spanish-speaking Latin America — aggregating investment and savings products into a single digital switchboard.

Workforce management infrastructure for the foodservice industry. Worc connects restaurant and hospitality operators to on-demand workers while providing the tools to manage, recruit, schedule, and develop employees — replacing fragmented manual hiring processes with a unified platform for the sector's highest-turnover workforce.
Direct-to-consumer brand infrastructure — curating and selling health and performance-focused consumer products.
Collateralized credit platform for the young and underbanked in Mexico — enabling users to build credit history through secured lending.

B2B marketplace connecting SMB wholesalers to retailers through an end-to-end platform — product discovery, embedded fintech, logistics, and order management. Zax is restructuring Brazil's traditional wholesale distribution channel, replacing in-person sales routes and manual ordering with digital infrastructure that serves the long tail of retail.
